title: Refactor Algorithm Boards to Pure Native Proxies
description: All algorithm boards (drag, diff, copy/paste, delete, etc.) must be pure UI proxies to native implementations. No additional domain logic in any board. Specifically: drag is showing correct piece centers but connections are missing, and diff is showing wrong information. Refactor all boards to be 100% clean UI that just calls native functions.
summary: Refactored all 6 algorithm boards to be pure UI proxies with no domain logic. Added `nativeFlatDesign()` helper that returns flat designs WITH connections preserved (only applies piece position updates from flatten, not connection removals). Updated `nativeDragPieces()` and `nativeMovePieces()` to use this pattern internally, returning `inputDesign` (flat with connections), `output` (flat with connections), and diff. All boards now use flat designs directly as `design` and `diffDesign`, eliminating the `diagramLayoutDiff` hack. Fixed root cause: `flattenDesign()` sets `flatDesign.connections = []` and its forward diff includes `connections.removed` — all boards were applying the full forward diff, losing connections.
